Small UX release from open GitHub issues ([#12](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/12), [#13](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/13), [#14](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/14)).

### Fixed

* **App card click** — whole card opens the app; start/stop/restart and other in-card controls still work ([#14](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/14))
* **Integration stats** — AdGuard and other integration metrics stay visible on the card without hover ([#13](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/13))
* **Disk & network bindings** — telemetry interface/mount settings are normalized and deduplicated on save; Settings help text explains the format ([#12](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/12))

### Install / Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid:

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh after upgrade (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). **Settings → System** should show `v1.5.5.6`.
